title: JuICE: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Judge in Identifying Cultural Errors

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of LLM-judges to detect and classify thick cultural errors (such as cultural inaccuracy, incoherence, specificity/stereotyping, connotation, and missingness) at the span and sentence levels within open-ended, long-form generated responses across diverse target cultures.

Assessing LLM-judges' performance in identifying explicit mechanical language mistakes and implicit sociolinguistic failures (such as inappropriate tone, register, or localized linguistic nuances) in native languages and English.
